description: C10: drag-cube pipeline on assembled vessels (PhysProf-S, -M2, -L2-AS) during a scripted vertical ascent from the KSC pad (all engines of the first stage, full throttle, SAS on). States are the first physics frame at which altitude reaches 1, 2.5, 5, 10, 20, 40 km or Mach reaches 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, plus the last frame: 'apex' (vertical speed turned negative), 'final' (90 s cap) or 'breakup'. Values are read after the frame's FlightIntegrator update. aoa_sweep is synthetic: on the same live occluded cubes, part.DragCubes.SetDrag(R(aoa) * part.dragVectorDirLocal, (float)fi.mach) with R a rotation about the vessel's ReferenceTransform.right expressed in part space, followed by FlightIntegrator.CalculateDragValue; the live state is restored afterwards (aoa 0 reproduces the live values).
oracles: FlightIntegrator.UpdateAerodynamics / UpdateOcclusion (DragCubeList.SetPartOcclusion through attach nodes), DragCubeList.SetDrag, FlightIntegrator.CalculateDragValue

provenance.decimal_format: normalized from _hex by harness/captures/tools/normalize.py (harness ExactNumber.FormatFloat/FormatDouble on .NET Framework ToString G6..G9 / G15..G17)
